title: Skin Diseases Classification
subtitle: Transfer Learning for Dermatology
description: A TensorFlow/Keras research project for classifying five dermatological conditions — acne, hyperpigmentation, nail psoriasis, SJS–TEN, and vitiligo — from images. It prepares a balanced dataset of up to 2,000 images per class, applies augmentation, and splits the data into 70% training, 15% validation, and 15% testing sets.
story: The notebooks and matching Python scripts evaluate transfer-learning models including VGG16, ResNet50, DenseNet121, and hybrid/ensemble architectures, with accuracy plots, classification reports, confusion matrices, and Grad-CAM explainability workflows.

title: Heart Disease Quantum Data Preprocessing
subtitle: R-based Dataset Preparation
description: An R-based data preprocessing project for a quantum machine learning dataset aimed at heart disease prediction. The workflow includes normalization, missing value imputation, and correlation analysis tailored for the dataset's unique quantum-inspired features.
story: The final output is a clean, analysis-ready dataset for building robust classification models.
